units: <cite ref="Taanit 6a:6">Taan. 6ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01616"><he>מַלְקוֹשׁ</he></cite>. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1) (play on <he>מקשת אסרו</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 22:3">Is. XXII, 3</cite>) <he>מקַשְׁיוּתָם נמסרו וכ׳</he> for their stubbornness they were given over to the governments.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:15">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> (ref. to <he>רבה קשת</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 21:20">Gen. XXI, 20</cite>) <he>רָבָה וקַשְׁיוּתוֹ עמו</he> he (Ishmael) grew, and his stubbornness with him; [anoth. vers.] <he>רבה וקשיותו אמו</he> he grew, and the cause of his renitence was his mother (who encouraged him in his sinful ways); a. e.

senses.gloss: erection, sensual desire. Ib. s. 98 (play on קשתו, Gen. XLIX, 24) ק׳ שנִתְקַשֵּׁיתָה וכ׳ the sensual desire which seized thee when thou wast with thy mistress.
